articles.summary: VANCOUVER, CANADA (August 5, 2026) – Vizsla Silver Corp. (TSX: VZLA) (NYSE: VZLA) (Frankfurt: 0G31) (“Vizsla Silver” or the “Company”) is pleased to announce the appointment of Luis Lázaro as President, Mexico for Vizsla Silver, effective immediately. As President, Mexico, Mr. Lázaro will lead in-country operations and oversee the continued advancement of the Company’s flagship Panuco silver project through permitting, […]
articles.title: VIZSLA SILVER APPOINTS LUIS LÁZARO AS PRESIDENT, MEXICO - Vizsla Silver Corp.
